    AI Overview
    For the 2026 Masters, weekend coverage (Saturday, April 11, and Sunday, April 12) begins at 12:00 p.m. ET on Paramount+ and the Masters App, with CBS television coverage following from 2:00–7:00 p.m. ET. Tee times for Saturday and Sunday begin in the morning, with featured groups starting earlier, around 8:55 a.m.. 
    Weekend Schedule (ET): 
    • Saturday/Sunday Morning: Early tee times.
    • 12:00 p.m. - 2:00 p.m.: Live streaming on Paramount+ and Masters.com.
    • 2:00 p.m. - 7:00 p.m.: TV Coverage on CBS. 
    You can check specific, updated tee times on the
    Official Masters Pairings Page.
